source: nflverse play_by_play_2025.parquet REG + roster_2025.csv for receiver position

definitions.plays: offensive snaps: season_type==REG and play_type in {pass, run} (kneels/spikes/special excluded)
definitions.shotgun_pct: mean of nflverse shotgun flag (0/1) on those snaps
definitions.under_center_pct: 1 - shotgun_pct. No pistol column in this PBP file; pistol (if any) is inside the not-shotgun bucket and is therefore counted as under center here — we cannot split it.
definitions.dropbacks: pass_attempt==1. nflverse pass_attempt already includes sacks (REG 2025: pa|sack == pa). Not qb_dropback (that also counts scrambles).
definitions.checkdown_pct: among dropbacks with a target (receiver_player_id present), share where roster position is RB/HB/FB AND air_yards is not null and air_yards <= 1. Receiver position joined from roster_2025.csv on gsis_id; 2025 REG targeted throws all matched.
definitions.rb_target_pct: targets to RB/HB/FB regardless of air yards, divided by dropbacks
definitions.avg_air_yards: mean air_yards on targeted throws with non-null air_yards
definitions.starter_qb: passer_player_name with the most dropbacks for that club
definitions.backup_gap_pts: only if backup_dropbacks >= 40: clamp(backup_gap_epa * 8, -4.5, 0). The 8 is a crude translation of EPA/dropback into spread points (0.125 EPA/play ≈ 1 point of spread). Clamped to [-4.5, 0] so a backup who outplayed the starter is not priced as a plus. Sample < 40 → null; do not invent 3.5.
definitions.team_codes: WSH not WAS; LAR not LA; JAX not JAC. Mapped from nflverse abbreviations.
